description: Present a UI component to the user. Every node, the root included, selects a component with `_type` and provides its props inline; nest components with `children`, and wrap several top-level components in one layout component.

_type.description: The component to render. "Header": A section heading. Renders as a bold title.; "Text": A run of text. Use for paragraphs, labels, or inline copy.; "Caption": Secondary, de-emphasized text under a primary element.; "Fact": A label/value pair, rendered as a key followed by its value. Use for compact metadata, and put an answer's key figures side by side in a `Row`.; "Card": A module the reader scans or acts on, such as a summary, a checklist, a form, or one option in a comparison. It renders as a panel, so keep plain sections (a `Header` with `Text` or `Markdown`) outside cards, and do not wrap the whole answer in one card or nest cards. It takes on a framed surface when `background` is set, when `confirm`/`cancel` add a footer, or when it is a slot in a `Carousel`. Set `asForm` to collect named child control values on submit.; "Col": A vertical stack; children laid out top to bottom.; "Row": A horizontal row; children laid out left to right.; "Spacer": Empty space that pushes neighbors apart.; "Badge": A small labeled tag, e.g. for status or category.; "Box": A generic container for composition, e.g. a progress bar built from an outer track Box containing a partial-width fill Box. Size, radius, and background accept arbitrary values, so they render as inline styles rather than data-attribute hooks.; "ListView": A vertical list container. Wrap `ListViewItem` children as rows.; "ListViewItem": A row inside a ListView. Carries `_action` to make the whole row clickable and keyboard-activatable.; "Steps": Numbered steps to follow in order, such as instructions or a how-to guide. Each step has a short `title` saying what to do and an optional `detail` on how.; "Timeline": Events in time order, each with a time or date label, such as a schedule, an itinerary, or a history.; "Table": Tabular data. Provide `columns` and `rows`; each row is an array of cells matching the columns.; "Markdown": A markdown string. Rendered as-is by default; override this component for a full markdown renderer.; "Citation": A source the answer draws on, shown as a card with its title and site that links to it. Use one per source.; "Alert": A highlighted message conveying urgency. `tone` drives the severity.; "Divider": A horizontal rule between sections.; "Chart": A chart. `variant` selects bar, line, sparkline, or area rendering. Provide `data` for a single series, or `series` for multiple named series (`series` takes precedence over `data` when both are present). Set `stacked` to accumulate series values instead of overlaying them, and `showAxis`/`showLegend` to add y-axis ticks, x-axis point labels, and a legend. Use for numeric trends or comparisons (2-30 points). Label every point.; "Comparison": Side-by-side comparison of 2-4 options: optional criteria rows (one value per option), pros/cons and a verdict.; "SpecSheet": A spec sheet / profile: a title and label-value rows (product specs, a customer profile, a campaign summary).

_key.description: Stable identity for this UI node. Use it for list items that may reorder.

anyOf.description: The text or number to display.
The fact value as text or a number.
Series color (single-series mode only). One of `emphasis`, `secondary`, `alpha-70`, `white`, `white-70`, or `white-50`, matching Text's `color` tokens; other values have no visual effect.

label.description: The fact label (key) as text or a number.

anyOf.description: Optional card title text or number.
The source's title as text or a number.

padding.description: Padding in 4px units (e.g. 2 = 8px). 0 to 8 is the supported range.

anyOf.description: Background color or gradient (any CSS background value). Setting this also switches the card's own text to white, since a custom background makes the card a tinted surface; children can still opt into a different color explicitly.
Background color or gradient (any CSS background value).

asForm.description: Render as a form; submitting it fires `confirm._action`, or the Card's own `_action` when `confirm` has none, with every named child control's value keyed by `name`.

confirm.description: Confirm button shown in the footer.

label.description: Footer button label text or number.

_action.description: Action fired when the button is activated.

type.description: The action type, resolved by the host's action registry.

cancel.description: Cancel button shown in the footer.

label.description: Footer button label text or number.

_action.description: Action fired when the button is activated.

type.description: The action type, resolved by the host's action registry.

gap.description: Gap between children in 4px units. 0 to 8 is the supported range.

radius.description: Corner radius; "full" is a pill/circle, a number is pixels.

title.description: What to do, in a few words, as text or a number.

detail.description: How to do it, or what to watch for, as text or a number.

time.description: When it happens, as the user should read it, such as `Day 1`, `6:00 pm`, or `1969`, as text or a number.

title.description: What happens, as text or a number.

detail.description: More about it, as text or a number.

kind.description: Format kind. `percent` takes a fraction, so 0.25 renders as 25%.

url.description: Link to the source; only http and https links open.

source.description: Where it comes from, such as a site or publication, as text or a number. Defaults to the link's domain.

snippet.description: A short quote or summary of what the source says, as text or a number.

flush.description: Whether the divider spans the full width with no inset.

data.description: Data points for a single series.

series.description: Multiple named series; takes precedence over `data` when present.

label.description: Series label, shown in the legend.

color.description: Series color. One of `emphasis`, `secondary`, `alpha-70`, `white`, `white-70`, or `white-50`, matching Text's `color` tokens; other values have no visual effect.

stacked.description: Accumulate series values instead of overlaying them (bar and area variants; ignored for line and sparkline).

showAxis.description: Show y-axis ticks and x-axis point labels.

showLegend.description: Show a legend mapping each series to its color.

name.description: Option name, e.g. a product or plan.

badge.description: Short tag such as 'Khuyên dùng' or 'Rẻ nhất'.

values.description: One value per option, in the same order as `options`.
